auth: none; answered only over plain http from a home network
notes: Before a phone sends its key to an address over plain http, it asks this with a nonce it picked (16 to 128 characters). proof is the lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256, keyed with the SHA-256 of the phone's token, of "share-home-proof:" followed by the nonce: only the phone's own server keeps that hash. Over https or through Cloudflare's tunnel the answer is 404 not_found, so an impostor elsewhere can't fetch one from the real server and pass it on. An unknown or signed-out device is 404 too. example is a worked case for the tests.
